name: @mapcairn/docs
description: MapCairn documentation site: Docusaurus, built to static files and served at /docs/ by a second Worker

scripts.generate: node --import tsx scripts/generateTheme.ts && node --import tsx scripts/generateApi.ts && node --import tsx scripts/generateRoadmap.ts && node --import tsx scripts/generateRepositoryDocs.ts
scripts.build: npm --prefix ../.. run build:sdk && npm run generate && docusaurus build && node --import tsx scripts/verifyBuild.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../.. run build:sdk && npm run generate && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm --prefix ../.. run build:sdk && npm run generate && vitest run
